summary: Resolve a peer read's Fabric tunnel once per forwarding attempt, sharing it between capability inspection and the operation

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery changes.

schema.detail: No persistent state, SQL, schema versions or generated contracts change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, digest or fleet rules change.

compatibility.detail: Every required capability still receives a fresh signed GET before the separately signed POST. Owner selection, authority, refusal propagation, hop limits and deadlines are unchanged. HTTP and legacy non-inspected reads retain their existing exchanges; no capability or tunnel address is cached across attempts.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption. Capability-gated Fabric reads remove one redundant local dial subprocess per attempt; no measured fleet latency improvement is claimed.

manual.detail: No operator action or coordinated upgrade required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new rollback restrictions.
